verdict.rationale: Temporal's Client API lets applications programmatically start Workflow Executions, send Signals/Queries, and Schedules/Versioning allow updating and activating workflow code paths (temporal-docs-32, temporal-docs-13/14/29/34, temporal-docs-15/25/35), and Temporal explicitly markets AI-agent orchestration integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK) (temporal-docs-17/18/19/26). However the API surface is SDK/gRPC-based rather than a documented public REST/OpenAPI endpoint (temporal-probe-2 shows all OpenAPI/swagger paths 404), and there is no concrete example of an autonomous agent itself invoking these APIs end-to-end to create/update/activate a workflow. missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API (OpenAPI spec), and a concrete agent-driven example of programmatic create/update/activate.
